metadata.title: Secure-Server Relying System SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining how institutional systems rely on Secure-Server trust, posture, and lifecycle signals when making workload admission and execution decisions.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP inherits all execution-trust semantics, prohibitions, and lifecycle expectations from the Secure-Server Platform SSPP.

system-characteristics.system-description: The Secure-Server Relying System defines the contract by which orchestrators, schedulers, control planes, and admission systems consume normalized server trust signals. It ensures signals are interpreted in a bounded, non-transitive manner without granting implicit privilege or persistent trust.

props.name: relying-role
props.remarks: Consumes normalized server execution, posture, runtime, vulnerability, and lifecycle signals.

props.name: trust-consumption-model
props.remarks: Server trust signals must not be cached, inherited, or reused beyond the current decision context.

props.name: execution-assumption
props.remarks: Execution eligibility does not imply administrative, privileged, or emergency authority.

props.name: signal-authority
props.remarks: Only signals produced and normalized by the Secure-Server Platform may be consumed.

props.name: lifecycle-sensitivity
props.remarks: Lifecycle state signals must be evaluated for admission, continuation, and termination decisions.

system-implementation.remarks: Secure-Server Relying Systems evaluate server trust exclusively through normalized signals provided by the Secure-Server Platform. They must not generate independent trust assertions, perform remediation actions, or override platform-defined trust semantics.

components.title: Lifecycle State Signals
components.remarks: Provisioning, revocation, rebuild, and termination signals.

roles.title: Server Trust Architecture
roles.remarks: Defines how server trust signals are consumed by relying systems and ensures architectural alignment.

roles.title: Server Trust Governance
roles.remarks: Approves reliance rules, trust ceilings, and signal interpretation policies.

roles.title: Server Admission Operations
roles.remarks: Operates schedulers, orchestrators, and admission control systems that consume server trust signals.

roles.title: Server Security Signal Monitoring
roles.remarks: Monitors server trust and lifecycle signals for anomalies and escalation support.

control-implementation.remarks: Control satisfaction is achieved through correct consumption of Secure-Server trust signals. This SSPP does not implement controls directly.
